​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​2026 County Election Plan​s

Per KRS 117.066(4), a County Election Plan submitted prior to a Primary Election that is approved by the State Board of Elections applies for the entire calendar year.
